name: @edgemodders/lipsync-core
description: Lip sync for Cyberpunk 2077: a character's lip synced lines read from the game through REDbridge, one line's clip as curves, a head and its face solver to play it on, and lip sync made from when each letter of a line is spoken. For REDcode and its MCP server.
author: Edgemodders

scripts.build: node esbuild.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --noEmit false --outDir dist
